blocks.text: Organic compounds ki oxygen ke saath reaction wali oxidation aam taur par combustion (jalna) hoti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ethane ki combustion C₂H₆ + 2O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂ chhapi hai. Yeh balanced nahi aur product bhi ghalat hai: jalne se pani (H₂O) banta hai, hydrogen gas nahi. Sahi equation C₂H₆ + 7/2 O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O hai (dono taraf 2 C, 6 H aur 7 O).
Organic compounds ki oxidizing agents ke saath reactions, maslan:
i) Ozonolysis ozone (O₃) se alkenes ko oxidation ke zariye kaatne ka tareeqa hai.

blocks.alt: 1-Propene H3C-CH=CH2 O3 ke saath ozonide halqa deti hai; Zn/H2O se acetaldehyde (H3C-CHO) + formaldehyde (HCHO), jo reduce ho kar ethanol H3C-CH2-OH aur methanol CH3-OH bante hain.
blocks.caption: i) Propene ki ozonolysis (kitab ke safha 268 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke khaake mein propene se ozonide wala teer dono taraf (reversible) chhapa hai. Ozonide ka banna aik taraf ki reaction hai, is liye oopar seedha teer hai. Acetaldehyde aur formaldehyde ethanal aur methanal ke purane (common) naam hain.
ii) Alkene ki epoxidation bhi oxidation reaction ki misal hai. Is mein oxygen molecule aur metal catalysts jaise mukhtalif oxidizing agents istemal ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Alkene (H2C=CH2) + O2 se epoxide (do carbons aur ek O ka teen-rukni halqa), jo H+/H2O ke saath ethane-1,2-diol deta hai.
blocks.caption: ii) Alkene ki epoxidation (kitab ke safha 268 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: iv) Primary alcohols acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ (acid mila potassium dichromate) se react kar ke carboxylic acids banate hain; is ki tafseel class 12 mein parhenge. Kitab mein is list mein (iii) nahi hai, (ii) ke baad seedha (iv) aata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: [O] ka matlab hai oxidizing agent se milne wali oxygen, aur [H] ka matlab reducing agent se milne wali hydrogen. In ko equation mein aise likhte hain taake asal reagent ka poora formula likhna na pare.
Carbon-carbon double bond par hydrogen jur kar alkane banna organic reduction reaction ki misal hai.

Organic synthesis mein mukhtalif reducing agents istemal hote hain, maslan LiAlH₄, NaBH₄, Sn + concentrated HCl. Nitriles se amines, amides se amines, carboxylic acid se primary alcohols aur nitrobenzene se phenylamine banana, yeh sab reduction ki misalein hain aur class 12 mein parhi jayengi.

blocks.prompt: C₄H₈ ka position isomerism dikhane wala isomer batayein, ethoxy methane aur propanol kis qisam ke isomers hain, aur alkenes mein kaun si structural isomerism mumkin hai (Quick Check 11.9a se c)?
blocks.explanation: But-1-ene CH₂=CHCH₂CH₃ aur but-2-ene CH₃CH=CHCH₃, C₄H₈ ke position isomers hain. Ethoxy methane CH₃CH₂OCH₃ aur propan-1-ol CH₃CH₂CH₂OH dono C₃H₈O hain magar functional groups alag (ether aur alcohol): functional group isomers. Alkenes mein chain isomerism (but-1-ene aur 2-methylpropene), position isomerism (but-1-ene aur but-2-ene) aur cycloalkanes ke saath functional group isomerism (but-1-ene aur cyclobutane) ho sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: In mein organic redox reactions pehchanein: oils ki margarine mein hydrogenation, bromine water se unsaturation ka test, aur methane ka jalna.
blocks.explanation: Hydrogenation mein C=C par hydrogen jurti hai: reduction. Methane ke jalne mein oxygen jurti hai (CO₂ aur H₂O bante hain): oxidation. Bromine ka addition is organic maane mein na oxygen jorta hai na hydrogen hatata hai; yeh electrophilic addition hai.

items: Oxidation: combustion (C₂H₆ → CO₂ + H₂O), ozonolysis, epoxidation, acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se primary alcohol → acid.
Reduction: alkene + H₂ (Pt) → alkane; ethanal + 2[H] (LiAlH₄) → ethanol; reducing agents LiAlH₄, NaBH₄, Sn/conc. HCl.
